title: im new and stuck looking for some help

comments.author: turk-fx
comments.body:

If you dont know what to tell AI to do certain thing, you cant do anything. I am wibe coder and coming from Engineering bacmground and worked as a programmer. I have no idea about advance trading practices/industry standards. If I didnt have my engineering background, I woulsnt be able to do this. Even with this, slow moving project compared to other things I finished in a day. Go learn about stock markwt, trading, sofware engineering fundamentals, system deaign principle etc... You dont need to be pro on all of these, but have enough background to ask right questions and tell the model correct prompt to get the good result. 

Same principle of the life applies here: Garbage in, garbage out...

comments.author: RemoraEdge
comments.body:
Ai training bots? Or trading bots. I’m assuming trading bots.

To create a trading bot you should already know how to trade or have a profitable strategy that is mechanical. Even discretionary systems need to be broken down into repeatable systems that you can actually code.

Or if you want an AI to trade for you and not write an actual algo, then that’s different. You will still need to teach it a profitable, repeatable, rules based system. And you’ll need to spend money if you want it actually trading for you and watching the markets. The usage can add up if you are going this route and even then it’s very risky. AI can be very forgetful and start doing things you don’t want it to do. It’s not the same as programming an actual algo to trade for you.

comments.author: J2YME
comments.body: There’s no way around it you need to read some books. Most digestible I found were options trading crash course by Richmond, investopedia website and the learn section on barchart.com. My advice is paper trade like crazy. No real money until you’ve at least doubled your paper account. You’ll only lose it otherwise.
